cookieConsent.title: Save your progress on this device?
cookieConsent.lead: SpillArena stores a few small things in your browser so you stay signed in and your progress follows you between the games.
cookieConsent.scope: Your answer applies to all of SpillArena – the front page and every game.

without.signin: You aren't remembered. You have to sign in again every time you open a game or reload the page.
without.progress: If you play without signing in, your XP, levels and records are gone when you close the tab.
without.results: Rounds you play while signed out aren't posted under your name on the leaderboards.
without.settings: Theme, accent color and language reset on every visit.

cookieConsent.storedTitle: What is stored in your browser

session.title: Keeps you signed in
session.body: Your username and a sign-in key that lasts up to 30 days, so you don't have to sign in again in every game. Your PIN is never stored here.

settings.title: Your settings
settings.body: Whether you chose light or dark mode, your favourite color and your language.

choice.title: Your answer to this question
choice.body: Whether you said yes or no, so we don't ask again. This is saved even if you decline.

cookieConsent.server: Only if you create an account, this is also saved on our server: your username, a protected version of your PIN that nobody can read, and your progress in each game.
cookieConsent.noTracking: No tracking or analytics cookies, and your data is never sold. Ads, where shown, come from Google with their own consent choice. See the privacy policy for details.
cookieConsent.manage: See what is stored and change your choice
cookieConsent.statusAccepted: Your sign-in and settings are saved on this device, so your progress and results follow your account.
cookieConsent.statusDeclined: Nothing is saved on this device. You have to sign in again each visit; while signed in, progress and results are saved to your account.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: SpillArena is a free hobby project run by Emil Berglund in Norway. This page says what is stored, why, and how to remove it.

sections.h: What we store on our servers
p: Only if you create an account: your username, a salted hash of your PIN (never the PIN itself), a hash of your recovery code, the dates you registered and were last seen, your XP and per-game progress, and the scores you post to leaderboards. If you choose a profile picture, we also store its DiceBear style, random seed and any selected details and colors; the picture is generated locally in your browser.
We do not ask for or store an email address, real name, phone number or location for accounts or games, and we do not store IP addresses in our own database.

If you use the contact form we store your message, your email address, the name you enter, the topic, your username, account creation date and last activity time if you are signed in, and a one-way hash of your IP address that changes every day and cannot be turned back into the address. It is used only to limit how many messages one sender can post per hour. Messages are kept for at most a year, and we can delete yours on request.

sections.h: What we store in your browser
p: If you accept storage: a sign-in token that lasts up to 30 days, and your theme, accent colour and language. If you decline, these are not kept and you start fresh on every visit. You can change your answer any time under “Storage & privacy” in the footer.

Pages that show ads also let Google store cookies and similar identifiers in your browser. What Google may store, and whether ads may be personalised, follows the choice you make in Google’s consent message, not the answer above.
Every game works without an account. Guest results stay in your browser and never reach a leaderboard under your name.

Cloudflare hosts the site and our database and sees ordinary request data (such as IP address) to deliver the pages and protect against abuse. We use Cloudflare’s own traffic statistics, which do not use cookies.
Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, so your browser contacts Google when the page loads. We use no tracking pixels or social-media widgets.

Ads: SpillArena can show ads from Google AdSense to help cover running costs. Only pages that show ads load Google’s ad code. On those pages, Google and the ad partners it works with use cookies and similar technology to show ads, limit how often you see the same one, measure them and prevent fraud, and, only if you allow it, to personalise them based on your activity here and on other sites. In the EEA, the UK and Switzerland, Google asks for that consent in its own message, built on the IAB Transparency and Consent Framework. You can change your choice at any time with “Ad settings” under “Storage & privacy”, or with the privacy and cookie settings link Google adds to the page. How Google uses this data: policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites. Your SpillArena account, PIN, progress and contact messages are never shared with Google or advertisers.

Account data is processed to provide the account and leaderboards you asked for (contract). Contact messages are processed to answer you (your request). Browser storage is kept only with your consent. Spam protection and security logging are a legitimate interest. Ad cookies and personalised ads require your consent, which Google’s message asks for; Google processes ad data under its own privacy policy.

You can rename your account on your profile page. To have your account and progress deleted, or to get access to or correct your data, contact us (see below); we will also remove your leaderboard entries on request. You may complain to Datatilsynet, the Norwegian Data Protection Authority.
The site is not aimed at children under 13 and we do not knowingly collect their data. Choose a username that does not reveal your real name.
If this policy changes, the date at the top changes too.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: By using SpillArena you agree to the following. It is short on purpose.

p: SpillArena is a free collection of browser games, provided as is, without warranty. Games may change, break or disappear, and progress or scores may be reset.
You are responsible for keeping your PIN and recovery code safe. Anyone who has them can act as you. Do not share them.
Usernames appear publicly on leaderboards and in multiplayer rooms. No offensive, hateful or impersonating names, no cheating, automated play, or attempts to attack, overload or probe the service.
We may rename, remove or ban accounts and remove scores that break these terms, without notice.
Drawings and words you submit in multiplayer games are visible to other players in that room. Do not submit anything unlawful or that you do not have the right to share.
To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for losses from using or being unable to use the service.
Norwegian law applies.

items.a: Yes. No payments and no downloads. Some pages show ads, which help cover running costs.
No. An account only saves your XP and progress and puts your name on leaderboards.
Pick a username and a 4–6 digit PIN. One account works in every game.
Use your recovery code on the “Forgot PIN” page. Keep the code somewhere safe; it is shown when you create your account.

items.q: Why does it ask about storage?
items.a: To remember your sign-in and settings on this device. Say no and the games still work, but nothing is remembered. Pages with ads also show Google’s consent message: that is a separate choice, about ads only. See the privacy policy.

items.q: Can I play against other people?
items.a: Some games have online multiplayer rooms. Others are played against bots or solo.

items.q: How do I delete my account?
items.a: Email support@spillarena.no. We delete the account, its progress and, on request, its leaderboard entries.

items.q: I found a bug or a bad username.

items.a: After five wrong PINs an account locks for 15 minutes. Wait it out, or use your recovery code on the “Forgot PIN” page.

items.q: How do I change my username?
items.a: Open your profile and choose rename. You confirm with your PIN. Scores already on a leaderboard stay under the old name.

items.q: Why is my score missing from the leaderboard?
items.a: Only results played while signed in are listed under your name. Guest results stay in your browser.

items.q: Does it work on my phone?
items.a: Yes, in any modern mobile browser. There is no app to install.
Yes. Use the settings menu in the header. The choice is remembered if you accept storage.
